verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a Teams API for deployment automation, audit logs and reporting, so a machine-readable spec is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence shows that an OpenAPI or equivalent spec is published, and probes of standard spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known/openapi.json) all returned 404. The existence of an API alone does not earn credit toward a downloadable spec.
